title: TikTok Shop Profit Calculator: Unit Economics and Commission Guide
summary: Calculate exact TikTok Shop profits. Master platform referral fees, affiliate commission rates, sample costs, and true net margin formulas.
body_markdown:
## Strategic Creator Commissions & The Weekly Sales Delta


### Understanding Creator Affiliate Commission Structures


Creator affiliate commission is generally a percentage of attributed sales, with eligible order value and discount treatment governed by platform terms. Research on TikTok Shop affiliate programs places typical rates between 10% and 20%. A 15% commission on a $50 order equals $7.50. Model it as a variable selling expense.


Use approved rate, attributed orders, cancellations, and refunds in affiliate reporting. A high commission can be sound when it creates incremental demand; a lower rate can still lose money when the creator receives credit for organic purchases.


### Setting Profitable Commission Rates: A Category-Specific Matrix


Set the commission ceiling from contribution economics. Subtract landed cost, referral fee, processing, fulfillment, and refund reserve from selling price, then reserve target contribution profit. The remainder is available for creator commission, paid media, and sample acquisition.


Build a matrix with average price, gross product margin, return rate, fulfillment cost, creator rate, and retained contribution profit. Products priced at $40 or more generally need at least a 60% gross product margin to absorb creator payouts and shipping while preserving net profitability, according to the cited research. Use the **FastMoss TikTok Data Analytics Platform** to examine category sales patterns and creator activity before setting rates.


### The Weekly Sales Delta: Measuring Creator Video Lift Profitably


Weekly Sales Delta isolates creator lift from the organic baseline: **weekly sales delta = sales during creator activation − expected organic sales.** Estimate the baseline from comparable weeks with similar price, inventory, promotions, and traffic. Multiply incremental units by contribution profit after commission and sample allocation.


Track baseline units, creator-attributed units, total units, commission expense, sample cost, and incremental contribution profit by week. Review launch response, sustained conversion, and later decay. A video that creates a spike but negative incremental contribution should not receive automatic renewal.


### Protecting Your Margins: When to Adjust Commission or Product Pricing


If incremental contribution is positive and inventory is available, retain the rate. If sales rise but contribution turns negative, reduce commission or revise the offer. If conversion is weak despite strong traffic, inspect the product page, price, reviews, and fulfillment promise before increasing payout.


For a $50 item, moving from 15% to 20% commission reduces contribution by $2.50 per attributed order. Track weekly sales delta, refund-adjusted revenue, creator payout, sample amortization, and contribution margin together.
